name: CodeSplit
description: A professional, browser-based integrated development environment (IDE) built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. This application provides a robust coding experience for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a Monaco Editor instance with advanced productivity tools and instant live preview capabilities.

paragraphs: A professional, browser-based integrated development environment (IDE) built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. This application provides a robust coding experience for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a Monaco Editor instance with advanced productivity tools and instant live preview capabilities.
features: Monaco Editor Integration: leverages the same powerful editor core as Visual Studio Code.
Multi-File Architecture: Dedicated tabs for index.html, styles.css, and script.js with language-specific syntax highlighting.
IntelliSense & Autocomplete: Advanced code completion for HTML tags, CSS properties, and JavaScript syntax.
Emmet Abbreviation: Built-in support for Emmet expanders (e.g., div.container>ul>li3 + Tab).
Automated Formatting: Integrated Prettier support for one-click code formatting.
